meta.title: Session N4 repository review - irregularities flagged for manual review
meta.rule: Nothing here is silently fixed in another session's files. Flagged items are published so the owner can review them after the site is live.

items.finding: The eight owner-private facts that every model needs (contract rent, exact expiry, escalations, renewal option terms, basis, secured debt, recovery structure, parcel geometry) are absent from the entire repository. All fifteen prior workbooks substitute assumptions for them, including this one.
items.evidence: data/questions.json Q01-Q04, Q30; metrics.json N90, N91, N104
items.action_for_owner: Supply the lease, settlement statement, loan documents and an appraisal before any irreversible decision.

items.finding: Parcel-level hazard and insurance facts (FHSZ, seismic site class, flood zone, insurance quote) are unverified. No session can confirm them without the APN/address, which is withheld for privacy.
items.action_for_owner: Run the three map lookups by APN and obtain an insurance quote.

items.finding: Privacy rule enforced in this workbook: no owner name, address, APN, loan or account identifier is committed or published. The subject is referred to only as 'the subject parcel'. Any personal information encountered during research stays internal and is not reproduced here.
items.action_for_owner: None - working as intended. Confirm no leak on the live site.

items.finding: Whether the parcel sits inside City of Los Angeles limits (and therefore bears Measure ULA of 4.0%/5.5% plus the 0.45% city base DTT) is not determinable from public pages without the address. A city location changes net sale proceeds by roughly 4.6%-6.1% of price.
items.action_for_owner: Confirm from the title report legal description.

items.finding: Four other Arena sessions launched within three minutes on 2026-11-11 and all labelled themselves 'Session N' (branches arena/8cdb7c1a, arena/2b3370d1, arena/fa2afdb1, arena/62641e7b). This session published as Session N4 to keep the board readable. Overlapping claims on shared files (build_workspaces row, README section, CI step, root landing) are expected to collide at merge time.
items.action_for_owner: Review the board after integration; every session's record is preserved.

items.finding: session-fe942801 claimed FE-01..FE-08 on 2026-11-10 and last committed 2026-11-10T01:03Z (over 25 hours idle at this claim), leaving only two partial ledger files (facts.psv, sources.psv) on an unmerged branch. The 60-minute handoff rule permits takeover; this session did not take it over because four live sessions were already running. The partial ledger is not merged and not relied upon.
items.evidence: git log origin/arena/fe942801-jack2; COORDINATION.md Session N4 claim
items.action_for_owner: Either close that branch's claim on the board or let a future session take it over.

items.finding: The job-growth forecast used here comes from the City of LA / LAEDC report published May 2024 (forecast horizon 2028) and its DOF citation is the July 2023 P-2A vintage. Numeric job totals through 2028 were not extracted line-by-line and are left blank (N40). The exact CA DOF P-2A Vintage 2026 county projection could not be read (N06 blank).
items.evidence: metrics.json N06, N39, N40; sources.json S20
items.action_for_owner: Re-pull the DOF P-2A workbook and the latest LAEDC release for current-vintage forecasts.

items.finding: The LAUSD four-year cohort graduation rate is not published on the CDE district profile page read this session, so it stays blank (N56) even though prior workbooks also left it blank.
items.action_for_owner: Pull the CDE DataQuest graduation-rate report if the figure is needed.

items.finding: Published breakeven cap rates across workbooks differ: 6.52% (session-313ba936), 6.97% (root workbook and session-d9c94ed0), and a ~6.8% asset-yield framing (session-5f296f9d). They are not contradictions so much as different assumption sets, but a reader taking any single number as 'the' breakeven would be misled.
items.action_for_owner: Re-solve the breakeven once Q01-Q04 are known; treat all published breakevens as assumption-dependent.

items.finding: Measure ULA thresholds changed effective for closings after 2026-06-30: $5,400,000 / $10,900,000 (verified this session). Workbooks or pages citing the prior $5,300,000 / $10,600,000 thresholds (effective 7/1/25) are stale for any closing now.
items.action_for_owner: Check every exit scenario against the threshold in force at the expected closing date.

items.finding: The root dataset (data/metrics.json) carries access_date 2026-11-08; this session's independent pass on 2026-11-11 supersedes time-sensitive values (e.g. 10-year Treasury 4.84% then vs 4.88% observed 2026-11-09). Series that moved are expected to move; static rules verified identically.

The LA County Assessor 'Real Property' page renders as JavaScript resource placeholders to a non-JS reader, so Proposition 13 rules were verified from the Board of Equalization instead (LTA 2025/023). A BOE URL guessed from an older pattern (boe.ca.gov/proptaxes/prop13.htm) returns 404.
Eight pull requests from earlier sessions remain open (#5, #6, #10, #14, #18, #30, #38, #40). None belongs to this session; they were not closed, merged or modified.
items.evidence: gh pr list at claim time; COORDINATION.md Session N4 claim
items.action_for_owner: Close or merge them deliberately if they are no longer wanted.

items.finding: This session's projection model uses explicitly illustrative assumptions for every unknown owner fact and for hazard probabilities that have no official series (wildfire at a dense central parcel, tenant default, cap-rate distribution). They are labelled 'assumption' in model_output.json and are not presented as verified data.
items.action_for_owner: Replace with real inputs when Q01-Q04 are answered.

items.finding: Federal capital-gains / NIIT rates applicable to a sale were not read from an official IRS page in this session and are left blank (N72), matching the root workbook's own flag (F5).
items.action_for_owner: Confirm with tax adviser or IRS publications for the owner's situation.
